Method of Attack: Exploitation of high-severity vulnerabilities in Salt management framework allowing remote code execution with root privileges
Authentication bypass on master server allowing pushing commands executed as root
Path traversal providing access to entire filesystem of master server
Impacted Systems: LineageOS infrastructure services including mail servers, download mirrors, statistics, download portal, Gerrit Code Review collaboration system
Attack Vector: Exploitation of vulnerabilities CVE-2020-11651 and CVE-2020-11652 in Salt master server remotely over the internet
Indicators of Compromise: More than 6,000 vulnerable Salt instances exposed to public internet at time of report
Intrusion detected on May 2, 2020 at around 8 p.m. PST targeting LineageOS infrastructure
